get_neighbors_nvidia: build a python module to find nearest neighbors using NVIDIA nvalchemiops with periodic boundary conditions and a cutoff radius
radius_graph_pbc_nvidia: build a python module to generate a radius graph with PBC support using NVIDIA accelerated neighbor search
get_neighbors_nvidia_atoms: build a python module to find nearest neighbors of an ASE Atoms object using NVIDIA nvalchemiops and return distances
test_get_neighbors_nvidia: test the get_neighbors_nvidia function with a batched tensor of atomic positions and unit cells
review_radius_graph_pbc_nvidia: review the radius_graph_pbc_nvidia function to verify it returns edge_index, cell_offsets, and neighbors tensors
